summary: Verified the new Sell-to-merchant flow + Dice-page sheet-roll animation feature end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_shop_sell.py (12 tests) covering sell creation, ownership/auth gating, duplicate 409, closed-merchant 400, item-not-in-equipment 400, list-requests `kind`+`final_price_gp` fields, approve with override (gold credited, one instance of duplicate item removed), approve without override (uses proposed price), approve fails when item already gone (400), purchase final_price_gp echoes price, deny/cancel still work for sell rows. 12/12 PASS. Combined with existing test_shop.py: 33/33 PASS. Frontend Shop: 'Sell to {merchant}' button visible in DM status strip, sell-modal opens with equipment dropdown / price / note / submit; submit posts to /api/shop/sell-requests and pending strip shows the 'Sell' chip (verified visually + DOM). Frontend AdminShop Requests tab: pending sell row shows kind chip 'Sell' (req-kind-{id}) and a 'Haggle to' input (sell-override-input-{id}); approve with override=33 → wawa gold went 175→208, 'Iron Dagger' removed (one instance), toast 'Bought from wawa: Iron Dagger' fired; non-sell rows do NOT expose the override input (verified — only 1 input across 2 pending rows). Frontend Dice page: posting a sheet roll via /api/dice/rolls (player_name+pc_id matched) caused dice-display to update within ~3s with the spinning then settled value (roll-label='Ability — STR', roll-total=18, dice rendered with mod+3), and the live feed (dice-feed) shows the roll; quick-d20 still rolls and animates exactly once (total=8 observed).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/shop.py:424 — On approve with kind=='sell', `final_price_gp` is taken from body or falls back to req.price_gp; that's correct. However `body.final_price_gp` is bound only if FastAPI parsed the JSON body; pass-through without body uses None branch (tested OK).

/app/backend/routes/shop.py:428 — `equipment.remove(item_name)` removes a single occurrence (verified: wawa had 2x 'Iron Dagger' → after sell, 1 remains via pytest, then 0 via UI test). Good behavior for duplicates.

/app/backend/routes/shop.py:336 — `request_sell` checks merchant.is_open BUT NOT stock/inventory of pc beyond name match. Edge case: PCs can spam sell-requests if they don't approve. Mitigated by the duplicate-pending check at line 353.
/app/backend/routes/shop.py:455 — `final_price_gp` only set on approve; deny/cancel leave it unset (None). request_out exposes it as None on those rows which is fine.

/app/frontend/src/pages/Dice.jsx — seenRollIds dedup logic works. Confirmed: sheet roll posted externally animated on /dice within ~3s and quick d20 still triggered exactly one animation. Polling interval is 2s — minor: a player viewing /dice will see up to 2s lag, which matches the agent_to_agent note.
/app/frontend/src/pages/AdminShop.jsx:511 — sell-override-input is type-coerced to int; empty string falls through to backend proposed_price. Verified empty-override path via pytest.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (sell modal submit + pending strip, admin haggle/approve + gold/equipment update, dice sheet-roll animation, quick-d20 regression)
